rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesChoose: Choose a board size and the number of mines, then place your bet.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesOpen: Open tiles one at a time. A gem raises the multiplier; a mine ends the round and the stake is lost.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesCashout: Cash out any time after at least one gem. Cash out is not offered with no tile open.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesPicks: Autobet opens the tiles you picked on the board in order; if none is a mine the round is cashed out at once.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesFreeRound: A bet of 0 plays a free round — nothing is staked, nothing is paid; the board still deals and reveals.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesIdle: A round left without a decision for 24 hours is finished by the server: with tiles open it is cashed out at its value; with none, the first tile is opened and, if safe, cashed out.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesFormula: After k gems on a board of N tiles with m mines, the multiplier is 0.99 × C(N, k) / C(N−m, k).
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesFormulaWords: That is {pct}% of the fair odds for opening k safe tiles in a row — the house keeps 1%.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesPayout: The payout is the stake times the multiplier, rounded down to the smallest unit of your currency.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesRTP: Theoretical RTP before rounding and any payout cap: {pct}% (1% house edge). A capped payout can reduce the return.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesMaxWinBehaviour: If the next tile would take the payout above the round's max win, the tile is not opened and the round is cashed out at its current value.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesAllRevealed: When the round ends every mine is revealed.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesExampleIntro: On a {side}×{side} board ({tiles} tiles) with {mines} mines, a bet of {stake}:
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesExampleNote: Numbers from the game's own code — the same math settles every round.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesMaxWinCap: A round can win at most {cap}. The round auto-cashes at the last tile that still fits.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesAutobet: Autobet plays rounds on the tiles you picked, at the stake and count you set, and stops on a profit or a loss limit you name.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMinesFair: The mines come from an HMAC-SHA256 of a server seed, your client seed and the round's nonce, placed before any tile is opened. The server commits to its seed by showing you the hash first; when you change the pair, the seed is revealed and every round can be replayed.

rulesMinesRTP.E02 (10 Oct): The return is exactly {pct}% at every cash-out point, for every board and every mine count.
rulesMinesRTP.E08 (19 Oct): Theoretical RTP before rounding and any payout cap: {pct}% (1% house edge). A capped payout can reduce the return.
